title: Time Stealers
html:
In this week's MondayMotivator,

Time is the most precious commodity we have.

We are restricted to twenty-four hours each day. What we do with them is important because we will never have them back.

If you use it wisely, you will be pleased later. If you use it badly, you will have regrets.

Why do some days seem so fulfilling and full of accomplishment, and yet others seem to run out of time? Because you can't save time, you can only manage it. And managing your time is the key to a less stressful but more fulfilling life.

Stop other people's circumstances from stealing or wasting your time.

People who value life less, are not organized, have little to do, or have no goals find it easy to impose on others' time or space. It is a waste of time to try to live in the past; it is equally a waste of time to live in the future. By all means, plan for your future, but never live in it.

Live only in the present.

Living in the present means being fully engaged in the current moment, not dwelling on the past or worrying about the future current moment, not dwelling on the past or worrying about the future.

Make life exciting, manage your time profitably, and have fun. Never waste a moment. Unless you are able to live fully in the present, the future will be a disappointment because each day is a gift. It is pure stupidity and a terrible loss to waste it by continually anticipating tomorrow. If you are anxious to waste an hour, then waste it on planning a better life.

To help live in the present, think,"Each day my time is limited, so I will treat it as a valuable commodity so that later I will have no regrets.

I have this day that has been given to me, and I will not waste it but use it to its fullest to experience true fulfilment and a sense of achievement. I will avoid those circumstances and people who want to steal my time or their purposes.

My time will be spent on worthwhile pursuits and people who can help my personal development."
